comment: The Terminology Service should cover biospecimen and research-data terminology alongside clinical terminology, enabling laboratory and biobank data to be safely interpreted, reused and exchanged across studies and countries.

anchor.note: p.164 l.7–15; 25–30 read as the printed page

public.text: The Terminology Service should cover biospecimen and research-data terminology alongside clinical terminology, enabling laboratory and biobank data to be safely interpreted, reused and exchanged across studies and countries.
public.suggestedRevision: Include standardised concepts for sample type, collection method, parent/aliquot relationships, processing method, storage condition, quality indicators, consent category, access conditions and research-study metadata. Support mapping of local laboratory and biobank terms to recognised national and international terminologies.
